An '''uprising''' of [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Miner/Legends|miners]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] was incited by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents. The uprising led to a major [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Battle of Mygeeto (Galactic Civil War)|counterattack]] that crushed the uprising.<ref name="Strongholds" />
